data.long_meaning: Safiyaah is derived from the Arabic word 'safa', which means 'pure, chaste'. It is a female name in Islamic tradition and is the name of a prominent woman in the Qur'an. The name Safiyaah carries the meaning “Pure, Chaste” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Safiyaah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, chaste and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Safiyaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Chaste.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Safiyaah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: صفية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم صفية مشتق من العربية، و يعني المرأة الطاهرة الخالية من الشوب، و يدل على النقاء و الطهارة، و هو اسم إحدى زوجات النبي محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم، و هي صفية بنت حيي بن أخت النجدي، كانت من السابقين إلى الإسلام و من أمهات المؤمنين

in_urdu.name: سفیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: سفیہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پاکیزہ، خالص، بےداغ، یہ نام نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی زوجہ صفیا بنت حیی بن اخت النجدی کے نام سے مشہور ہے، جو اسلام کی ابتدائی پذیرندگان میں سے ایک تھیں اور مومنات کی امہات میں شمار ہوتی ہیں

in_hindi.name: सफिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: सफिया नाम का अर्थ पवित्र, शुद्ध, निर्मल होता है, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, और इस्लाम में इसका बहुत महत्व है, यह नाम नबी मुहम्मद की पत्नी सफिया बिन्त हुय्यी के नाम से प्रसिद्ध है, जो इस्लाम की प्रथम स्वीकृतिदाताओं में से एक थीं और मुमिनों की माताओं में गिनी जाती हैं

in_english.name: Safiyaah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Safiyaah originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the word 'safiyyah' (صفية), which means pure, undefiled, chaste, and clean. This name holds significant importance in Islamic tradition as it was the name of one of the wives of Prophet Muhammad, Safiyyah bint Huyayy. She was a prominent figure among the early converts to Islam and is regarded as one of the mothers of the believers. The name symbolizes purity, innocence, and spiritual cleanliness, making it a highly revered and sought-after name in Muslim cultures
